combo_label: Tools & DIY × Magic & Illusion × The Wild West

entries.clue: Stout metal rod, tightened by a nut, that holds a frame together
Fine-toothed blade in a bowed frame, the choice for cutting metal
Long straight blade pushed through the basket, harming nobody inside
Jangling spiked wheels strapped at the heels of riding boots
Arena contest of bull riding and roping, won for a prize buckle
Settler's claimed plot with a cabin, staked out on open land
Young male horse, and the gunmaker whose name is stamped on the grip
Band of armed townsfolk riding out together to run down a gang
The magician's rapid talk, or the sound of rain on a window
Dull first coat put on bare plaster so the colour above will hold
Threaded fastener that bites in deeper the more you turn it
Deck of painted fortune-telling pictures laid out on velvet
Rise slowly into the air with nothing at all holding you up
